items.title: Dave McKenna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I did a record date with him for a Japanese label in June in New York, with Michael Moore and Jake Hanna

ctx.x: Harry, gee he’s so young too.

He’s playing great. I went — Frank Tate, the bass player took a band to Ireland and England last November, and Harry knocked me out. I knew he played well, he’s far beyond that now, and then I did a record date with him for a Japanese label in June in New York, with Michael Moore and Jake Hanna, there was four of us. And I really enjoyed that too.
Anybody in particular writing tunes today that you think may become standards?
